skill.name: azure-reliability
skill.description: Assess and improve reliability for Azure Functions and Azure App Service. It checks zone redundancy, storage redundancy, health probes, and multi-region failover, then guides confirmed remediation through Azure CLI or IaC.
skill.summary: Assess Azure Functions and App Service reliability, then guide confirmed CLI or IaC remediation.

content.value_statement: Azure PaaS apps often hide single-region and storage redundancy gaps. This skill finds gaps and guides confirmed Azure CLI or IaC remediation.
actual_capabilities: Discovers Azure Functions and App Service resources in a selected subscription, resource group, or app scope.
Checks zone redundancy, storage redundancy, health probes, and multi-region failover posture.
Builds a feature-pivoted reliability checklist with affected resources and current status.
Guides staged remediation with Azure CLI, Bicep, Terraform, or Azure Developer CLI workflows.
Adds multi-region failover guidance using secondary deployments and Azure Front Door after confirmation.
limitations: Only covers Azure Functions and Azure App Service in this version.
Requires Azure authentication and enough Azure role permissions for assessment or changes.
Infrastructure changes can affect cost, deployment state, or running applications.
It does not replace full architecture review, load testing, or business continuity planning.

use_cases.title: Assess Production Readiness
use_cases.description: Review a production resource group for zone redundancy, storage redundancy, health probes, and failover gaps.

use_cases.title: Patch Reliability IaC
use_cases.description: Update Bicep or Terraform definitions so reliability changes survive future deployments.

use_cases.title: Plan Regional Failover
use_cases.description: Design an active-passive Azure Front Door failover path after core single-region reliability is complete.

prompt_templates.title: Assess One App
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess reliability for my Azure Functions app named <app-name> in resource group <rg>. Show zone redundancy, storage redundancy, health probes, and multi-region status.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Resource Group
prompt_templates.prompt: Check reliability posture for resource group <rg> in subscription <subscription>. Summarize gaps by feature and ask before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Patch Existing IaC
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess my Azure App Service deployment and patch my Bicep or Terraform files for safe reliability fixes. Show the deploy plan before running anything.

prompt_templates.title: Design Multi-Region Failover
prompt_templates.prompt: After confirming core reliability is complete, generate a multi-region failover plan with a secondary region and Azure Front Door. Include cost and deployment checkpoints.

output: Zone redundancy is off for one compute plan, storage uses LRS, health probes are partial, and multi-region failover is off.
The next step is a yes or no choice to apply quick wins or patch IaC.

output_examples.input: Patch my Terraform for reliability improvements.
output: Terraform patch plan prepared for zone redundancy and health probes.
Storage redundancy is separated into a later migration step because it can take hours or days.
Deployment waits for explicit confirmation before any apply step runs.

output_examples.input: Set up multi-region failover for my function app.
output: The skill first confirms single-region reliability is complete.
It then proposes a secondary region, Azure Front Door routing, health probes, and cost impact.
No multi-region files or deployment commands run until the user confirms.

best_practices: Run an assessment before and after significant infrastructure changes.
Use IaC patching when the app is deployed through Bicep, Terraform, or Azure Developer CLI.
Confirm cost, downtime, and resource recreation risks before applying changes.
anti_patterns: Running live changes without confirming scope and impact with the user.
Bundling storage redundancy migrations with quick safe patches.
Using this skill for unsupported services such as Container Apps.

faq.question: Which Azure services does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Azure Functions and Azure App Service. Container Apps support is listed as planned, not current.

faq.question: Does the skill make changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. It asks for user confirmation before running Azure CLI commands, deployment commands, or multi-region setup.

faq.question: What permissions are required?
faq.answer: Reader access is enough for assessment. Contributor access is required for configuration changes.

faq.question: Can it update Terraform or Bicep files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide patches for Terraform or Bicep and separates safe changes from storage migration steps.

faq.question: Can it help with disaster recovery planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide multi-region failover planning with a secondary region and Azure Front Door.

faq.question: Is this a full security or architecture review?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on reliability posture for supported Azure PaaS services and does not replace specialist review.
